baseline.objective_role: formal baseline only; every alternative view is diagnostic and cannot become a new objective in this stage

candidate_gradient_vectors.global: central/one-sided finite differences on the unchanged 25x25 beta grid; concatenate both gradient fields for cross-subject cosine
candidate_gradient_vectors.local: central differences at beta=[0,0] using K0287/K0337 for beta_flex and K0311/K0313 for beta_extend
candidate_gradient_vectors.preference_evidence: direction/sign differs, not merely gradient norm or proportional scale

decision_rules.CURRENT_HETEROGENEITY_TRAJECTORY_INTERAC: at least two physically meaningful diagnostic representations satisfy REPRESENTATION_ORDERING_EVIDENCE, at least one is a force component, and at least one has direction_disagreement_fraction>=0.05
the ADEQUATE conjunction is false after all preregistered diagnostics pass integrity checks
decision_rules.CURRENT_OBJECTIVE_INFORMATION_RETENTION_: at least two upstream raw/time/peak/component representations satisfy REPRESENTATION_ORDERING_EVIDENCE, combined J does not, and at least one preregistered normalization/RMS/component-aggregation loss condition is met
the LIMITED conjunction is false after all preregistered diagnostics pass integrity checks

next_stage.BOTH_OBJECTIVE_AND_HETEROGENEITY_LIMITIN: recommend the layer with stronger preregistered evidence first; do not execute

evidence_thresholds.AFFINE_COMMON_SCALING: median affine R2>=0.995 and median proportional NRMSE<=0.01
evidence_thresholds.COMMON_RANKED: median pairwise Spearman>=0.98 and direction_disagreement_fraction<=0.01 and median affine R2>=0.995
evidence_thresholds.MATERIAL_RMS_COMPRESSION: time-resolved/RMS-summary interaction RMS ratio>=2 for both joints and at least one preregistered time window satisfies REPRESENTATION_ORDERING_EVIDENCE
evidence_thresholds.NORMALIZATION_ORDERING_RETAINED: minimum within-subject raw-versus-normalized Spearman>=0.999999 and adjacent sign-change fraction=0 for both joints
evidence_thresholds.NORMALIZATION_ORDERING_LOSS: minimum within-subject raw-versus-normalized Spearman<0.99 or adjacent sign-change fraction>=0.01 for either joint
evidence_thresholds.REPRESENTATION_ORDERING_EVIDENCE: median pairwise Spearman<=0.95 OR direction_disagreement_fraction>=0.05 OR (interaction_fraction>=0.01 AND interaction_to_common_ratio>=0.10)
evidence_thresholds.parameter_association_descriptive: absolute Spearman rho>=0.70 and BH q<=0.10; magnitude-only association is not preference evidence

normalization_attenuation.absolute_interaction: two-way interaction RMS in source units
normalization_attenuation.dimensionless_interaction: interaction RMS divided by absolute grand mean
normalization_attenuation.interaction_fraction: interaction sum of squares divided by total centered sum of squares
normalization_attenuation.ordering_comparison: within-subject raw versus positive-reference-normalized ranks and all adjacent transition signs

peak_diagnostic.raw: maximum absolute joint torque from the frozen 24x625 compact landscapes
peak_diagnostic.reference_normalized: raw candidate peak divided by the same subject and joint reference-candidate peak
peak_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; no peak objective optimization

replay_subset.candidate_selection: V3 beta geometry only: reference, four corners, four axis extrema, four central neighbors, four deterministic interior points
replay_subset.subject_selection: nearest/farthest parameter centroid followed by deterministic greedy maximin in frozen 6-D unit-cube geometry

scientific_role: development-only offline diagnosis separating objective information loss from limited musculoskeletal subject-by-trajectory structural heterogeneity

subject_parameter_associations.method: exploratory Spearman with raw p and Benjamini-Hochberg q within each declared compact/passive/mass-inertia family; no predictive learner
subject_parameter_associations.preference_rule: association with gradient magnitude alone is recorded as PARAMETERS_MODULATE_RESPONSE_MAGNITUDE_NOT_PREFERENCE

time_resolved.interaction_metric: time-weighted RMS over t of sqrt(mean(subject-by-candidate interaction(t)^2))
time_resolved.rms_compression_ratio: time-resolved interaction RMS divided by interaction RMS of the corresponding reference-normalized full-cycle RMS summary
signals: signed tau(t) divided by same-subject reference RMS
time_resolved.window_boundary_rule: left-closed/right-open except the final third is right-closed; branch labels and segment_phase come from the frozen reference
